text:
```yaml
name: Stale Issues and PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 1 * * *'  # 1:30 AM UTC daily
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Mark stale issues and PRs
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          days-before-stale: 90
          days-before-close: 60
          days-before-pr-stale: 90
          days-before-pr-close: 60
          stale-issue-label: stale
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had activity in the last 90 days. If you want to keep it open, please add a comment or reassign it.
          stale-pr-label: stale
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had activity in the last 90 days. If you want to keep it open, please add a comment or reassign it.
          close-issue-label: closed
          close-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically closed because it has been stale for 60 days. If you believe this is a mistake, please reopen it and add a comment.
          close-pr-label: closed
          close-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been automatically closed because it has been stale for 60 days. If you believe this is a mistake, please reopen it and add a comment.
          exempt-issue-labels: lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned
          exempt-pr-labels: lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned
          exempt-all-issue-assignees: true
          exempt-all-pr-assignees: true
          exempt-all-issue-milestones: true
          exempt-all-pr-milestones: true
          remove-issue-stale-when-updated: true
          remove-pr-stale-when-updated: true
```
